events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, kicked off in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Summer of '69
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or track from the festival that defined a generation?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who passed away at his Graceland home.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The hip-hop world remembers influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since the passing of a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's words and music still resonate profoundly.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring the legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: That Iconic Cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her influence on rock music is undeniable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released his powerful album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant as ever.

events.title: Original iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: Remember The iPod?
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple introduced the original iPod, changing music forever. Did you have one of the first models?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Fans worldwide celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', premiering in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: The White Album Turns
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. Its eclectic sound and minimalist cover made it an instant classic.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
